m.aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, Śrī Bagalāmukhī, Mother. Let me perform your āratī.
m.aarti.pad1: Yellow garments grace your body; the beauty of your earrings is unique.
m.aarti.pad2: In your lotus hands you hold a mace; all men and women sing your praise.
m.aarti.pad3: A garland of champak flowers sways at your neck; gods, men and sages hail your victory again and again.
m.aarti.pad4: The threefold afflictions are all wiped away, every one; devotion to you always brings happiness.
m.aarti.pad5: You sustain, destroy and create the world; you are the guardian of all living beings.
m.aarti.pad6: All people wander in the night of delusion; bring light into their hearts.
m.aarti.pad7: Destroy the darkness and increase knowledge; O Ambā, you alone are the foe of the demons.
m.aarti.pad8: You always give happiness to the saints; you are dear as life to all people.
m.aarti.pad9: Whoever fixes his meditation on your feet, for him you take away every fear of worldly existence.
m.aarti.pad10: Those who perform your āratī with love are worthy of the abode of liberation.
m.aarti.do1: Whoever reads or hears the āratī of Bagalāmukhī — so prays Kulapati Miśra — may he have every happiness and wealth.
